card.name: Unit word right after a number
card.fires_on: The word right after a number plus unit, such as "percentage" before "points", or "less" after an amount like "5 mg" or "2 cm". It marks the word that completes a size or difference.

modes.label: Percentage points
modes.description: The word "percentage" after a number, before "points", in statistics about differences.
modes.example: It has an overall margin of error of plus or minus 2<< percentage>> points.

modes.label: Amount less than
modes.description: The word "less" after an amount with a unit, giving a reduction or difference.
modes.example: resume lenalidomide capsules at 5 mg<< less>> than the previous dose.

modes.label: Dose wording after mg
modes.description: A dosing word such as "dosage" or "weekly" right after a dose amount or frequency.
modes.example: Induction 2.5 mg once<< weekly>> 4 weeks Titration 2.
